brief:
Students at California State University, Long Beach assembled in significant numbers to oppose Israeli soldier and content creator Adi Karni's presence on campus, Eye on Palestine reported. Karni appeared outside the university library wearing an Israeli flag while holding a sign, drawing the student demonstration.

The protest reflected ongoing tensions on American college campuses over Israeli military figures and symbols. Details about the sign's message and the scale of the student turnout were not specified in available accounts.
